gloss: to catch, to make out, to hear clearly

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {聞|き}き{取|と}りませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {聞|き}き{取|と}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {聞|き}き{取|と}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To manage to hear and understand what is being said, especially when it is difficult to hear.

definitions.gloss: to interview, to take a statement
definitions.explanation: To gather information by asking questions and listening to responses (formal/official context).

examples.japanese: ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}れない。
examples.english: I can't make it out clearly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さくて→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}れなかった。
examples.english: The voice on the phone was too quiet and I couldn't make it out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早口|はやくち}→早口：04321_hayakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}されると→話す：00467_hanasu⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}り⟦にくい→〜にくい：02005_nikui⟧。
examples.english: When someone speaks quickly, it's hard to catch what they're saying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{騒|さわ}がしくて→騒がしい：17685_sawagashii⟧、⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}れなかった。
examples.english: It was too noisy and I couldn't catch the name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}れる⟦ようになりたい→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become able to understand Japanese news by listening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}った。
examples.english: The police took a statement from the witness.

⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}った。
examples.english: Opinions were gathered from the residents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}る⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.english: A detailed interview was conducted with the person in charge at the scene.

notes:
{聞|き}き{取|と}る is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to hear and catch what is said.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) → to take in what one hears

ASPECT (ている):
{聞|き}き{取|と}っている indicates an ongoing process of listening and understanding.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}る (catch someone's words)
- ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}れない (can't make out clearly)
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (interview survey)
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (listening comprehension test)

RELATED NOUN:
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り: listening comprehension; interview/hearing

LANGUAGE LEARNING:
Often used in the context of language learning, referring to listening comprehension skills.
